messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis | Where to Watch |
|-------|------|----------|----------------|
| **An Inconvenient Truth** | 2006 | Former U.S. Vice‑President Al Gore presents scientific evidence on climate change and urges urgent action. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film and highlights new scientific findings. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **Before the Flood** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to meet scientists, activists, and affected communities, illustrating the human impact of climate change. | Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **The 11th Hour** | 2007 | Produced by Leonardo DiCaprio, this film features interviews with leading environmentalists and scientists, offering a comprehensive look at ecological crises. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **Climate Change: The Facts** | 2019 | A BBC production that explains the science behind climate change, its impacts, and potential solutions. | BBC iPlayer (UK), Amazon Prime Video (US) |
| **A Plastic Ocean** | 2016 | Investigates the extent of plastic pollution in oceans and its effect on marine life, linking it to broader climate issues. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |

These films are widely available on major streaming platforms and provide both scientific context and compelling storytelling. If you’re looking for something more recent or region‑specific, let me know and I can help narrow it down!
